name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Timber Tile Fastener
tagline: SPACER TAB FOR PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED TIMBER TILE FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Timber Tile Fastener is an accessory used on top of pedestals to secure timber tiles and create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of timber tiles in raised flooring systems. Timber tile fasteners are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and has a locking mechanism using a screw. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Timber Tile Fastener is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and timber tiles, and it's locking mechanism locks into grooves on the sides of a timber tile.
